items.title: China Jet Order Could Be A Big Moment For Boeing (BA)
items.summary: Boeing recently agreed to sell 50 737-8 jets to China Southern Airlines' Xiamen Airlines, a roughly US$7.4b order with deliveries planned from 2031 to 2034, subject to required approvals. The Xiamen deal revives Boeing's commercial footing in China after a lengthy pause in major orders. It reinforces airline demand for 737 capacity while the manufacturer works through production constraints and certification milestones elsewhere in the portfolio.
